title: March Madness
summary:
Tanker fixtures jump as producers prime the pump
We are near the end of another week of almost unprecedented volatility in the oil and tanker markets. It seems that the COVID-19 outbreak has put people and markets on edge and any change in outlook or unexpected event has an outsized impact on the markets. After the OPEC+ meeting concluded without an agreement one week ago, a quick succession of events in the oil market turned the crude oil tanker market upside down.
